author: Widogeist
body: Items that have the "critical chain" effect give that bonus. It stacks up to 10, and crit hits will do progressively more damage until it caps. If your attack misses or you do a non-crit attack then the chain resets to 0. Item drops from this months super raid [Fallen King Centaurus](https://codex.fqegg.top/#/codex/raids/fallen-king-centaurus/) gives critical chain, and there are some other older items like [arisen riftrazor](https://codex.fqegg.top/#/codex/items/arisen-riftrazor/), [arisen manablades](https://codex.fqegg.top/#/codex/items/arisen-manablades/), and [arisen shadeblades](https://codex.fqegg.top/#/codex/items/arisen-shadeblades/).
